keyEvents.text: Goal! Bournemouth 1, Leeds United 0. Evanilson (Bournemouth) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Justin Kluivert.
Nico Elvedi (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Bournemouth 1, Leeds United 0.
Ethan Ampadu (Leeds United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Leeds United. Sean Longstaff replaces Gabriel Gudmundsson.
Substitution, Leeds United. Anton Stach replaces Ao Tanaka.
Substitution, Leeds United. Lukas Nmecha replaces Daniel James.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Junior Kroupi replaces Justin Kluivert.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Lewis Cook replaces Ryan Christie.
Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Álvaro Rodríguez replaces Evanilson.
Substitution, Leeds United. Jean-Mattéo Bahoya replaces James Justin.
Substitution, Leeds United. Brenden Aaronson replaces Harry Wilson.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Bafodé Diakité replaces Adam Smith.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Amine Adli replaces Rayan.
Goal! Bournemouth 2, Leeds United 0. Amine Adli (Bournemouth) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Junior Kroupi.
